purpose: Reversible record of fabricated placeholder publication dates removed from research/input/evidence/*.evidence.json. Each entry previously carried publishedAt = <year>-01-01T00:00:00Z, which widened year-only source metadata into a false exact calendar day. publishedAt was set to null. No replacement date was supplied: supplying a verified date is re-review work requiring source authorization and was out of scope.
notes: impliedYear is the year that was present in the removed timestamp. It is the only genuinely known publication metadata for these sources and is preserved here because the evidence-packet schema sets additionalProperties=false on sourceSnapshot, so no year-only field could be added in-packet.

Two WADA Prohibited List 2026 entries (andarine/wada-prohibited-list-2026 and s-23/wada-2026-prohibited-list-official) carried 2026-01-01, which is the List's entry-into-force date, not its publication date; the cited PDF URL is itself dated September 2025. They were nulled with the rest and are flagged for reviewer attention.
